RT by @lookner: Explosion disrupts Damietta LNG hub An explosion at Egypt's Damietta LNG terminal has disrupted operations at one of the country's key LNG import hubs after damaging the Energos Winter floating storage and regasification unit and the GasLog Salem LNG tanker. Both vessels have been moved offshore as authorities assess the situation, while an #LNG carrier scheduled to discharge at the terminal has also departed. GasLog Salem had been due to begin service as a floating storage unit on 1 August under a short-term agreement with state-owned Egas, supporting Egypt's expanding LNG import programme. With no official details yet on the cause, injuries or repair schedule, market attention is turning to the potential impact on near-term gas supply and terminal operations.
